text: Jeep is a brand of Stellantis N.V., whose largest shareholders include Etablissements Peugeot Frères (7.72%) and Bpifrance Participations (6.64%), the French state investment bank.
short: Jeep (with Visit Detroit) on the Juventus front is a brand of Stellantis N.V., the Amsterdam-domiciled, NYSE/Euronext-listed automaker.

source.name: Stellantis N.V. Form 20-F for FY2025, shareholder section (SEC)
source.quote: Établissements Peugeot Frères (“EPF”) (holding 7.72 percent of the issued common shares) and Bpifrance Participations S.A. (“BPI”) (holding 6.64 percent of the issued common shares).

additionalSources.name: Peugeot Invest (formerly FFP), company website asset page for Stellantis
